snippet.title: 0-Second Ending?! | DEBRISVERSE Official Trailer (Dystopian Incremental Game)
snippet.description:
Can you reach an ending in exactly 0 seconds? Crush space debris to pay off a $100 million debt in DEBRISVERSE, a sci-fi incremental simulation with a dark twist.

▼ Play the Demo & Wishlist Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433730/DEBRISVERSE/

---

This is not just another incremental game.

Follow the UI glitches, hack hidden terminals, and uncover a massive corporate conspiracy.

【Key Features】
・[Absurd Inflation] Upgrade your tools to obliterate massive amounts of debris with satisfying, screen-filling visual effects.
・[The Dark Side] Access "Illegal Shops" normally unreachable in standard play to uncover the secrets of B.R.I.S. Corp.
・[7 Branching Endings] Your actions outside company protocol act as hidden flags that determine your fate.
・[Major Next Fest Update] Face the story-critical boss "Mega Debris" in the updated demo! A public playtest is also live, allowing you to play through the entire first run.

■ Game Specs
Title: DEBRISVERSE
Genre: Sci-Fi Debris-Crushing Incremental Simulation
Platform: Steam (Windows PC)
Release Date: July 2026
Price: TBD
Developer/Publisher: Studio RELIER

Official Website:
https://relier.work/en/

X (Twitter):
https://x.com/studio_relier

Music： MusMus　https://musmus.main.jp/
